summary: Maase Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, PRC-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing the board's October 13, 2026 appointment of Mr. Baoxue Xu as Co-Chief Technology Officer overseeing the energy solutions division. The appointment is a routine, planned executive addition, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure. Xu receives no cash salary but was granted 12,500 restricted share units vesting over five years under a standard employment agreement. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is implicated; the filing is an ordinary current report with no special-situation angle.
